title: Projected US wealth transfer through 2048, by destination

source.name: US Advisor Metrics: The Cerulli Report -- The Great Wealth Transfer

notes: Cerulli projects $124 trillion in total US wealth transfer through 2048. Of that, $105 trillion is expected to flow to heirs and $18 trillion to charity (the two sum to $123T, a touch under the $124T headline total due to Cerulli's own rounding of residual/spousal categories). Roughly 81% of the total ($100T) originates from Baby Boomers and older generations.
